summary: Iteration 19 focused on the twice-reported settings cross-contamination bug. Backend: 18 pytest tests (new /app/backend/tests/test_settings_partial_iter19.py) covering PUT /api/settings as a true partial update in BOTH directions, invalid-input isolation, backward-compatible full payload, empty-body rejection, auth guard, plus incidental regression on bot/status, broadcast history/latest, broadcast validation (no live send), change-PIN roundtrip and welcome-image upload/serve/remove — 18/18 passed. Frontend: Playwright e2e on the public preview URL — unlock via PIN, welcome-text-only save, username-only save, invalid username, empty-Tamil-block save, defaults reset, broadcast history toggle. All passed; the reported bug is NOT reproducible in either direction. Dashboard state restored to the demo values (official_username=Heheheehejvjsjsjsjdjjdjdbdh, DEFAULT_TA/DEFAULT_EN, no welcome image, PIN 246810).

minor.issue: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins='*' (CORS_ORIGINS in backend/.env). Browsers reject credentialed requests with a wildcard origin; harmless today because auth is a Bearer header, but it is an invalid/misleading config. Preflight confirmed 'access-control-allow-origin: *'.

admin_attempts counters below MAX_ATTEMPTS never decay/expire (only docs already at the limit are deleted after the 15-min window), so isolated wrong PINs accumulate forever per IP. Found stale docs: 157.51.89.239 count=5 from 2026-08-10, 223.178.80.146 count=1.

ui_bugs.issue: setTimeout(() => setMsg(''), 4000) is never cleared, so a stale timer from a previous save wipes a newly-set status/error message early (observed: a validation error disappeared ~1.5s after appearing because the prior 'saved' timer fired). Cosmetic only.

action_items: No functional fix required for the reported bug — partial-update PUT /api/settings verified correct in both directions at API and UI level.
Optional: clear the ConfigPanel status timeout with clearTimeout before setting a new one so error messages aren't wiped by stale timers.
Optional: set an explicit CORS_ORIGINS list instead of '*' since allow_credentials=True is enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: write_settings() correctly gates each field on `is not None`, so PUT {welcome_ta, welcome_en} never calls clean_username() and PUT {official_username} never touches the welcome pair — the structural fix is sound. Note the welcome pair is still coupled by design: sending only welcome_ta backfills welcome_en from the DB, which is the intended behaviour.
public_settings() explicitly whitelists fields, so Mongo _id never leaks; verified across GET/PUT/welcome-image responses.
/app/frontend/src/App.js saveSettings(patch) now PUTs the raw patch (no merge with React state) — matches the backend contract and removes the previous state-merge race.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_settings_partial_iter19.py` as the regression suite for settings partial update. Note: multipart endpoints (broadcast, welcome-image) must NOT be called from a requests.Session that has Content-Type: application/json set — it yields a 422 'file field required'; use a fresh session (that was a test-harness bug, not an app bug). Never POST a non-empty broadcast in preview (~59 real Telegram users).
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: PUT /api/settings was a full-replace that required and re-validated all three fields on every save, so a welcome-text save re-ran clean_username() (username error) and a username save re-ran the welcome-pair check (welcome error). Current code validates/updates only fields present in the request body, and the frontend sends field-scoped patches. Verified fixed in both directions via API and UI.
